params.caption: 🎮 UK culture secretary calls GTA 6 "something we can be really proud of" Lisa Nandy, the UK's secretary of state for culture, media and sport, praised Rockstar's GTA 6 in an interview with The Rundown. She says she plays Animal Crossing and Mario herself and tied creative-industry investment to new jobs. It's a big shift from the Hot Coffee era, when politicians lined up to attack the series. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 20:12 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @RockstarGames 🇬🇧 React if you agree · 💬 Should governments back games like film and music? #GTA6 #Rockstar #UKGaming #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
